description: This file defines API routes for authentication-related operations in a FastAPI application. It includes models for OAuth flows, API key management, and handlers for login, callback, token refresh, and API key verification. The routes facilitate OAuth authorization initiation, callback processing with token exchange, token refresh, and API key storage and validation, integrating with external OAuth providers and internal token storage mechanisms.

classes.name: OAuthLoginRequest
classes.description: Request model for starting an OAuth login flow, including connector type, tenant ID, connection ID, authorize URL, client ID, scopes, and optional redirect URI.

classes.name: OAuthLoginResponse
classes.description: Response model containing the authorization URL and state token for OAuth login.

classes.name: OAuthCallbackResponse
classes.description: Response after OAuth callback handling, indicating success or failure, including connection and tenant IDs, message, and token expiry.

classes.name: OAuthRefreshRequest
classes.description: Request model to refresh OAuth token, including tenant ID, connection ID, token URL, client credentials, and optional extra parameters.

classes.name: OAuthRefreshResponse
classes.description: Response after attempting token refresh, containing status message and optional expiry datetime.

classes.name: ApiKeyUpsertRequest
classes.description: Request model to store or update an API key, including tenant ID, connection ID, API key, header name, and prefix.

classes.name: ApiKeyVerifyRequest
classes.description: Request model to verify an API key against stored hash, with tenant ID, connection ID, and API key.

classes.name: ApiKeyResponse
classes.description: Response model indicating verification result and message.

methods.name: _tenant_tokens_collection(tenant_id: str)
methods.description: Get the database collection for tokens of a specific tenant.

methods.name: str _encrypt_token(plaintext: str)
methods.description: Encode a token string into a base64 encrypted form (placeholder for real encryption).

methods.name: str _decrypt_token(ciphertext: str)
methods.description: Decode a base64 encrypted token back into plaintext.

methods.name: Optional[datetime] _upsert_oauth_tokens( *, tenant_id: str, connection_id: str, access_token: str, refresh_token: Optional[str], expires_in: Optional[int], )
methods.description: Insert or update OAuth tokens and their expiry times in the database for a specific tenant and connection.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] _get_oauth_record(tenant_id: str, connection_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieve OAuth token record for a specific tenant and connection.

methods.name: None _upsert_api_key( *, tenant_id: str, connection_id: str, api_key_plain: str, header_name: Optional[str], prefix: Optional[str], )
methods.description: Insert or update an API key hash in the database for a specific tenant and connection.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] _get_api_key_record(tenant_id: str, connection_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieve API key record for a specific tenant and connection.

methods.name: ApiKeyResponse set_api_key_async(req: ApiKeyUpsertRequest)
methods.description: Endpoint handler to store or update API key hash for a connection.

methods.name: ApiKeyResponse verify_api_key_route(req: ApiKeyVerifyRequest)
methods.description: Verify an API key against stored hash for a given tenant and connection.

methods.name: OAuthLoginResponse oauth_login(req: OAuthLoginRequest)
methods.description: Initiate an OAuth login flow, generating authorization URL and state token.

methods.name: OAuthCallbackResponse oauth_callback( request: Request, code: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Authorization code returned by the provider."), state: str = Query(..., description="Opaque state parameter returned by the provider."), error: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional error returned by provider."), error_description: Optional[str] = Query(default=None, description="Optional error description."), )
methods.description: Handle OAuth provider redirect, exchange code for tokens, and store credentials securely.

methods.name: OAuthRefreshResponse oauth_refresh(req: OAuthRefreshRequest)
methods.description: Refresh OAuth token using stored refresh token and update stored credentials.
